page.title: Generative UI
page.subtitle: What the agent can draw in its answers: tables, graphs, forms, quizzes, sketches of a page.

switch.title: Draw in answers
switch.on: On: the agent may answer with tables, graphs, forms and sketches.
switch.off: Off: the agent answers with text only.

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.hint: Each request opens a new chat with the text ready to send.
tryIt.disabled: Turn on drawing in answers first.

quiz.label: A quiz
quiz.prompt: Make me a quiz of 5 questions on Go goroutines, with explanations, and a button to send you my score.

cards.label: Flashcards
cards.prompt: Create flashcards of English travel vocabulary, with a category and a pronunciation on each.

essay.label: A writing exercise
essay.prompt: Train me to write in English: give me a subject of 100 to 150 words and a box to write my answer in.

sine.label: A graph to explore
sine.prompt: Make an interactive graph of sine, cosine and tangent with sliders for amplitude, frequency, phase and vertical shift, and show the current equation.

parabola.label: A parabola
parabola.prompt: Show me the parabola f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k with sliders for a, h and k, and mark its vertex on the graph.

site.label: A site sketch
site.prompt: Show me what the site of an artisan bakery could look like, with a colour palette.

dashboard.label: A dashboard
dashboard.prompt: Sketch a dashboard for a project management tool: side bar, key figures, a trend curve and a table of projects.

architecture.label: An architecture
architecture.prompt: Draw the architecture of a RAG chatbot on AWS: documents in S3, a Lambda that indexes them, a vector database and an API.

gallery.intro: Every example the agent is taught from, drawn as in the chat. Click a button or fill in a form: the message it would send is shown at the bottom, and nothing is sent.
gallery.nothingSent: Nothing yet: click a button, a choice, a quiz result or a form.
